The imports in `__init__`, `decorators`, `shell_completion`, `parser`, `exceptions` and `types` are updated, and all three import paths resolve to the same classes.

The full suite, excluding `tests/test_utils`, passes: 2079 passed, 24 skipped, 1 xfailed. I ran it after each job; each of the first two jobs ended with a green run.

There's no linter in this environment. I removed the now-unused imports by hand, so a ruff pass on your side would be worth doing.
